_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
One screen capture and its preview stay alive across navigation and return. The test seeded the conversation at /c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}} and another conversation {{VIEWED}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). Recording uploads are counted by call "uploads". "The preview" is [data-testid="recording-preview"], a video element. "The capture counts" are what eval "({sameStarts: window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts === window.__starts, displayRequests: window.__recordingMock.displayRequests})" returns. "The preview keeps its stream" when eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"recording-preview\"]').srcObject === window.__recordingPreviewSource" is true. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible.
2. Click the voice button. [data-testid="recording-status"] should have the text exactly "Recording…".
3. Click [data-testid="recording-screen-button"].
4. The recording panel should get data-mode "screen", and the preview should be visible.
5. Mark them in one eval: "(() => { document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"recording-panel\"]').setAttribute('data-instance-marker', 'screen'); const p = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"recording-preview\"]'); p.setAttribute('data-instance-marker', 'screen-preview'); window.__recordingPreviewSource = p.srcObject; window.__starts = window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts; return 'marked'; })()".
6. window.__starts must be greater than 0, and window.__recordingMock.displayRequests must be 1.
7. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer.
8. Exactly one recording panel and one preview should exist (count 1 each); the panel should still have data-instance-marker "screen" and the preview data-instance-marker "screen-preview". The preview must keep its stream, and the recorder should float.
9. The capture counts must be exactly {"sameStarts":true,"displayRequests":1}.
10. Click [data-testid="recording-return-button"]. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text").
11. Exactly one recording panel and one preview should exist (count 1 each); the panel should still have data-instance-marker "screen" and the preview data-instance-marker "screen-preview". The preview must keep its stream, and the recorder should not float.
12. The capture counts must be exactly {"sameStarts":true,"displayRequests":1}.
13. Click the cancel button. Call "uploads" must return "0".

steps.expression: (() => { document.querySelector('[data-testid="recording-panel"]').setAttribute('data-instance-marker', 'screen'); const p = document.querySelector('[data-testid="recording-preview"]'); p.setAttribute('data-instance-marker', 'screen-preview'); window.__recordingPreviewSource = p.srcObject; window.__starts = window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts; return 'marked'; })()
